assertion.statement: The p not dividing W local factors satisfy the same uniform estimates needed by the polynomial-forms proof; numerical identity of their values is neither needed nor asserted.
assertion.objects: Divisor-sum local factors for the actual polynomials W P_i+b_i, with W=E times the primorial.
assertion.hypotheses: E and the polynomial data are fixed before the cutoff, residues are units, nonconstant polynomial differences and coefficient-height bounds are retained.
assertion.quantifiers: Every permitted fixed polynomial family and all primes not dividing the chosen W, subject to the original good/bad-prime split.
assertion.parameter_range: Exactly the fixed-data ranges of current lines19989-20169.
assertion.uniformity: The constants retain their permitted dependence on fixed complexity and E; they do not acquire a dependence on the length or unbounded residue choice.
assertion.constants: The final polynomial-forms error is still o(1); no unchanged numerical Euler factor is required.
assertion.normalizations: The normalization phi(W)/W and small-prime exclusions are unchanged. For p not dividing W, W is invertible and the coefficient/root-count estimates retain their form.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Exceptional primes are controlled by the nonzero coefficient combinations; they need not be the identical exceptional set for every choice of W and residues.
assertion.limit_order: Fixed E and complexity, sufficiently small sieve exponent, cutoff, length, then the sufficiently slow diagonal.
